items.headline: Fitch Upgrades Albemarle Corporation's Ratings to 'BBB'; Outlook Stable
items.snippet: Supportive Lithium Demand: Lithium demand is supported by battery use in electric vehicles and by the rapid expansion of stationary energy-storage applications. However, potential industry overcapacity remains a key risk to lithium prices.

items.headline: Albemarle has surprising new reason to rally
items.snippet: Mizuho's updated forecast raised its 2027 lithium demand estimate by almost 10%. This development provides Albemarle investors with a second significant source of lithium demand.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Albemarle faces persistent headwinds from weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, and rising supply-chain costs. Zacks Underperform view.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory.
